description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A physical medicine physician needs to document cranial dimensions for an anthropometric assessment. Using InVesalius's linear measurement tool, place at least two linear measurements in the slice views: (1) the maximum transverse (left-to-right) diameter of the skull and (2) the maximum anteroposterior (front-to-back) diameter of the skull. Each measurement should span from one inner cortical surface to the opposite side. After placing both measurements, save the project to /home/ga/Documents/cranial_measurements.inv3. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
